comments.author: Dongwoo
comments.body:
Well I had mystery spices in my bazaar for a week and nobody bought, so I donated to my company mate. They were a dungeon drop in my case, Lima middle I think.

As for the precious r12 cooking from any job, an accessory like the ribbon and a cooking aide can give you that.

Anyway, I don't mean to spoil the business of the fellow player who makes the mittens :-). I have r15ed cooking - I considered them a while back when I was starting it and determined they weren't worth the 50M I had to buy them for in company shop. Others may think otherwise.

Also note they are a memo album reward too these days, so...

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Mittens + Ribbon + Cooking Aide + Mystery Spices = +8 Cooking. +9 if you're in a job has the skill as Expert. I can see how at the very least a Mittens-Ribbon-Spices combo would help give you (or maybe a friend you're helping out) a pretty nice boost at the early cooking levels. As with all things in this game, of course, there's multiple ways of doing something, and everybody has an approach or style that will work best for them. The important thing is to just have fun playing.
